## The answer about the leaf at night

Many people think a plant has chloroplasts in place of mitochondria. That is a reasonable guess, and it is wrong: **a plant cell has both**.

<!-- STEP -->
## Two different jobs

Chloroplasts make food in sunlight. Mitochondria release the energy in that food and store it as ATP, by day and by night. A root cell gets no sunlight, yet it stays alive because food reaches it from the leaves and its mitochondria release the energy.
